summary: Studio executed a custom 2D steady-state thermal simulation of the ATPlace2.5D Case 3 chiplet placement (8 dies, 39×39 mm interposer, 0.6 whitespace, ×32 D2D modules). The paper reports ATPlace2.5D achieves 92.3°C maximum temperature and 142.42 m wirelength versus TAP-2.5D baseline of 94.1°C and 185.2 m. Studio produced steady-state temperature predictions using a bundled thermal model (example.materials, package.config), yielding peak CPU temperature 283.07°C (556.22 K) and peak GPU 280.2°C. This Studio simulation is illustrative only and does not validate the paper's compact thermal model or placement optimization algorithm. Critical mismatches prevent numerical comparison: (1) Studio's absolute temperature scale (~283°C peak) versus paper's 92.3°C reflects different thermal material stacks, boundary conditions, and reference assumptions; (2) Paper uses quasi-homogeneous approximation (Eq. 6) with fitted parameters (A, a, B, l_x,i, l_y,i) not disclosed, while Studio applies generic bundled config; (3) Paper's compact model trained on HotSpot 6.0 64×64 grid with specific chiplet dimensions and power distribution not provided; (4) Paper assumes 0.1 K/W heatsink convective resistance and adiabatic lateral boundaries, whereas Studio's package.config may differ; (5) Floorplan coordinates in Studio experiment are normalized (0–0.0375 m range) and represent approximate placement, not the optimized layout produced by ATPlace2.5D's CGD solver; (6) Paper's 92.3°C is steady-state worst-case with specific λ_therm, λ_dens parameters and temperature threshold T_th, none disclosed. Studio's sensitivity check (CPU +1 W → +0.3 K) validates solver linearity but does not validate paper's thermal-aware optimization or physical applicability. Feasibility gate permits illustrative run only; comparison_valid flag is false.

Paper's compact model validated against HotSpot 6.0 with 64×64 grid (MAE 1.16°C, MAPE 3.23%, 2575× speedup); Studio run uses different solver and configuration
No transient analysis in either paper or Studio; steady-state assumption not validated against realistic workload thermal dynamics
Chiplet orientation discretization {0°, 90°, 180°, 270°} via projection function Bz and CGD optimization not implemented in Studio; floorplan is static

Multi-objective optimization parameters (λ_therm, λ_dens, temperature threshold T_th, exponent γ, learning rates lr_pos, lr_ang, Optuna hyperparameter settings) not disclosed; Studio does not optimize placement

Physical mismatches: 2D placement ignores 3D heat spreading through substrate C4 pillars and secondary cooling path; heterogeneous material interfaces at chiplet edges and interposer boundaries not modeled exactly in either paper or Studio
Legalization MILP constraints (minimum spacing w_gap = 100 μm, density target t_max) and numerical solver tolerances not disclosed; Studio floorplan not verified for legality
Paper reports 6 min runtime for ATPlace2.5D and 186 min for TAP-2.5D baseline (23× speedup); no runtime correlation with Studio execution
